Metadata.title: Taka Sats | Verified Recycling. Bitcoin Paid.
Metadata.description: Taka Sats verifies recycling work, links field evidence and enables transparent Bitcoin payouts for collection teams, even when connectivity is limited.
Metadata.shareImageAlt: Taka Sats: verified recycling work with transparent Bitcoin payouts

Home.description: Taka Sats gives collection teams an offline-first way to identify, weigh, prove and pay for recyclable material, with every step traceable.
Home.heroScreenAlt: Taka Sats supervisor home showing collection actions and session totals
Home.flowTitle: From collection to sats, step by step.
Home.flowDescription: The field team gets a simple guided journey. Taka Sats keeps the identity, evidence, checks and payout connected underneath.
Home.flowLedgerTitle: One record follows the whole journey
Home.flowLedgerDescription: Collector, material, weight, photo hash, session, rate and payout remain linked in the append-only ledger.
Home.flowIdentifyDescription: Find an authorized collector by staff-assisted search, public code or QR.
Home.flowWeighDescription: Select the material and record the scale weight against the active local rate.
Home.flowEvidenceDescription: Add the scale photo, time, session and location, or record why GPS is unavailable.
Home.flowSyncDescription: Save offline first, then sync for hash, assignment, rate and anomaly checks.
Home.flowPayoutDescription: Resolve the verified receive address, apply required approval and send the sats.
Home.productTitle: Fast enough for a collection line. Clear enough for trust.
Home.productDescription: Large targets, sunlight-ready contrast and a guided workflow designed for affordable Android phones.
Home.identifyAlt: Find a collector by name, public code or QR
Home.operateAlt: Collection session home with offline sync status
Home.trustTitle: Work first. Evidence with it. Payment after.
Home.trustDescription: Collector identity is separate from the wallet. Weight and photo evidence stay linked. Supervisors cannot approve their own payouts.
Home.ledgerTitle: Every confirmed fact joins the ledger.
Home.ledgerDescription: Collection, authorization, recycler sale and payout records form an append-only hash chain that can be independently verified.
Home.ctaDescription: Open the supervisor app and use the active pilot session.
Home.footer: Open infrastructure for verified recycling work and transparent Bitcoin payouts.

About.metaDescription: What Taka Sats is, why Afribit Africa is building it, and how every collection and payment is checked.
About.title: Pay people fairly for recycling. Keep an honest record.
About.lead: Taka Sats is free, open source software that lets a recycling programme weigh what collectors bring in, check it, and pay them in Bitcoin. Anyone can inspect the record of what was collected and what was paid.
About.problemTitle: Real work that is hard to prove
About.problemBody: Collecting recyclables is real work, but it is rarely recorded properly. Weights are written on paper or remembered. Payment comes late, in cash, or is disputed. Collectors have no proof of what they delivered, and the people who fund a programme have no proof that it happened.
About.step1Body: Staff look the person up by name or code. Each collector is approved by a staff member before they can be paid.
About.step2Title: The material is weighed and photographed
About.step2Body: The weight comes from a scale. A photo shows the material, the scale and its display. The phone saves everything, even with no internet.
About.step3Body: When the phone reconnects, the record is sealed so it cannot be changed quietly. The system checks the rate, the session, the supervisor and the photo, and flags anything unusual.
About.step4Body: A second person approves the payment. The sats go to the collector's own wallet. Nobody chooses the destination at payout time.
About.bitcoinBody: A collector does not need a bank account, an ID document or a special app to be paid. Payments over Lightning arrive in seconds and cost very little. A wallet the collector controls cannot be frozen by us or by anyone else. And every payment can be checked by people outside the programme.
About.openBody: Taka Sats runs on open standards. The code is free to read, copy and run under the AGPL licence, so any programme can host its own. By default collectors keep their own keys and the programme never holds money that belongs to a collector. We do not ask for ID numbers. Partners and funders see totals, not people.
About.honest1: Every collector is approved by staff first.
About.honest2: Weights come from a physical scale, with a photo as evidence.
About.honest3: Each record is sealed on the phone, so any edit is visible.
About.honest4: Repeated photos, repeated weights and unusual weights are flagged for review.
About.honest5: During the pilot, every payment needs a second person's approval.
About.honest6: What we paid for is compared with what the recycler accepted.
About.honest7: The ledger can be verified by anyone, so changed records show up.
About.statusBody: Taka Sats is ready for a supervised pilot. For now it runs in demo mode, which means payments are simulated and no real money moves. Before any real payment we will test with small amounts and a named group of staff.
About.whoBody: Taka Sats is built for Afribit Africa and designed so that other recycling and circular economy programmes can run it too. It is open source, so you can read every line, ask questions and help improve it.
About.footer: Taka Sats is open source software under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
